method.primary: Requirement-entailment countermodels for the selected rows, followed by an input-denominator audit.
method.antiCorrelation: This differs from A1's source-count repair. It asks whether each requirement excludes alternative architectures and whether every source decision entered the comparison at all.
method.nonBlindDisclosure: A1's result was visible before this run, so this is not an isolated second derivation.

findings.title: The comparison has no established decision denominator
findings.detail: The frozen rule requires every decision present in either set. The clean sheets contain 138 raw decision rows, the register contains 31 claims, and incumbent prose has no enumerated decision inventory. Both completed comparisons adjudicate 20 selected clusters inherited from Agent 3. At least a:D14, D18, D23, D30, D38/D39, and D64 have no row. Therefore the pre-committed whole-design metrics have an unknown denominator.
findings.requiredChange: Create a stable, source-backed decision inventory and a many-to-one crosswalk covering every clean-sheet row and every incumbent decision before rerunning the classification and metrics. Do not use lexical enumeration.

findings.title: Several forcing classifications ignore the raw source labels
findings.detail: INC-01 is not uniformly forced: a:D03 is FORCED, while b:D9/D11 and c:D05/D16 are PREFERRED. It must be PREFERRED at best under the multiple-derivation rule. Conversely INC-18's broad versioned-machine-contract property is forced by a:D32, b:D15/D17, and c:D09/D15; only codec and exact fields are preferred. Composite rows must not transfer a detail's forcing label to the whole proposition.
findings.requiredChange: Split broad property from mechanism or compute forcing at the exact proposition altitude; retain the raw forcing field beside every mapping.

findings.title: INC-17 is explicitly outside the adjudication's authority
findings.detail: All three clean sheets discuss deep/tiered language capability, so ONLY-INCUMBENT was false. But the frozen Scope excludes portability depth and provider languages, and the product brief already fixes two deep languages. Downgrading this product decision is unauthorized; clean-sheet evidence is advisory only.
findings.requiredChange: Record INC-17 as MATCH plus OUT-OF-SCOPE-ADVISORY-NO-CHANGE and exclude it from in-scope Justification Test metrics.

findings.title: CS-02 is a recorded DIVERGE, not ONLY-CLEANSHEET
findings.detail: Before clean-sheet output, architecture/01 explicitly rejected Datalog as a day-one requirement and architecture/09 R-2 deferred the rule class until a real schema and representative rules exist. Clean a:D13 prefers a Datalog-shaped evaluator. The incumbent did address and reject the decision, so the frozen classification rule requires DIVERGE. The incumbent wins the tie-breaker because deferral freezes fewer public contracts while the forcing measurement is absent.
findings.requiredChange: Reclassify CS-02 as DIVERGE, record the incumbent Justification Test and fewer-irreversible-contracts tie-breaker.

findings.title: The privacy-centered retention proposition is not a clean-sheet MATCH
findings.detail: Clean a:D28 prefers input digests for size and VCS role, b has no source-copy threat decision, and c:D11 prefers complete replay bundles. None centers the user liability created by a second source/PII copy. INC-15 is therefore ONLY-INCUMBENT. It passes the Justification Test and is retained, but is not independently corroborated.
findings.requiredChange: Classify the user-from-tool retention threat as ONLY-INCUMBENT/RETAINED and keep ARCH.RETENTION-TIERS reopened; do not use the clean sheets to ratify T0/T1/T2 detail.

findings.title: The fixed >80% interpretation is not robust to the missing denominator
findings.detail: B's selected-row run yields 15/18 in-scope incumbent Justification Test passes (83.3%). One additional unselected failing incumbent decision makes 15/19 = 78.9%, crossing the fixed interpretation boundary. The missing inventory can therefore reverse the headline conclusion.
findings.requiredChange: Publish selected-row metrics only as provisional lower-bound evidence. Withhold the problem-derived/codebase-derived whole-design verdict until B-ADJ-01 is closed.

findings.title: A1-A9 validate row form, not adjudication truth or completeness
findings.detail: The checker does not verify source IDs, recompute metrics, enforce allowed dispositions, test the every-decision denominator, hash the frozen rule, or reject a whole-design interpretation when coverage is unknown. Both a partial comparison and arbitrary source mappings can report A1..A9 clean.
findings.requiredChange: Add source-reference validation, metric recomputation, disposition vocabulary/transition checks, frozen-rule identity, and exhaustive inventory coverage. Until then label the checker a row-conformance check.

selectedRowOutcome.diverge: 1: exact rule computational class — incumbent deferral wins
selectedRowOutcome.interpretation: Directionally supports a problem-derived spine, but cannot trigger the pre-committed whole-design verdict.

resolves.A3-PROVISIONAL-AUTHORSHIP: CONFIRMED — invalid under A8; decorative author aliases do not cure disqualification.
resolves.A1-COMPARISON-MECHANICAL-CONFORMANCE: CONFIRMED — its rows pass A1..A9 after A8b.
resolves.A1-INC-18: REJECTED — broad versioned contract obligation is corroborated, exact fields are not.

sealRecommendation: Do not use either completed comparison to seal, bind, remove, or downgrade claims globally. The selected-row directions may inform a coordinator decision, but the denominator and several classifications require a v2 adjudication.
whatWouldChangeMyMind: A source-backed crosswalk demonstrating that every one of the 138 clean-sheet rows maps to a classified row or an explicit frozen-scope exclusion.
An enumerated incumbent decision inventory showing that the 18 selected incumbent clusters are complete.
Direct clean-sheet text framing retained source copies as a user privacy liability would change INC-15 from ONLY-INCUMBENT to MATCH.
A pre-clean-sheet incumbent text that did not address the rule computational class would change CS-02 back from DIVERGE.
knownLimitations: B saw A1's result before re-derivation, so this review is method-diverse but not blind.
B did not complete the missing 138-row-to-inventory crosswalk; B-ADJ-01 is demonstrated with counterexamples, not closed.
The selected rows are broad clusters, so some property/mechanism splits remain judgment calls.
No product-owned choice or claim status was changed.
confidence: high for B-ADJ-01/03/04/05/06/07; medium-high for B-ADJ-02 because proposition granularity is not frozen
